Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-hiv-transfer-reason-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-transfer-reason-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
relocating RelocatingThe client is relocating from the area served by the transferring facility.
closer-new-facility Closeness to new facilityThe receiving facility is more conveniently located for the client.
self-transfer Self transferThe client independently requested or initiated transfer to another treatment site.
stigma StigmaThe client is transferring because of experienced or anticipated HIV-related stigma.
pmtct PMTCTThe client is transferring for prevention of mother-to-child transmission services.

name: NgHivTransferReasonCS
title: NG HIV Care and Treatment Transfer Reasons
description: Reasons for transferring a client between HIV treatment sites, transcribed from the November 2025 HIV Care and Treatment Transfer Form.
